maria: Heads-up — I'm sketching a 'scope profile' flow for the console to attach role + scope + runtime constraints (quotas, routing policies, preferred model/region). Want quick feedback on the data model + UX. Example: assign 'Viewer' role scoped to tenant 'acme' + route '/api/ingest/*' + quota 10k tokens/day + prefer-region eu-west. Should this be a single wizard or split across Roles / Scopes / Quotas? @kevin @julia

kevin: Single wizard w/ progressive disclosure sounds best. Must show an "effective policy" preview that combines role + scope + constraints. Also show simulated token-cost estimate per day. For quotas we need both hard and soft limits (soft -> warn, hard -> reject/fallback). For routing policies: priority list + fallback chain.

anas: Security notes: every change needs an audit entry and optional approval step for enterprise tenants. Support KMS binding for secrets used by private deployments. Inheritance rules matter — explicit deny should trump allow; we need an obvious UI hint for that.

julia: From design POV I propose a 3-step modal: 1) Identity & role assignment (users/groups/service accounts), 2) Scope definition (route patterns, model families, regions), 3) Constraints (quotas, rate limits, routing priority, canary %). Preview panel on the right that shows final policy + example evaluated requests. I'll drop a mock in the figma link.

maria: Mock: https://figma.com/file/placeholder/scope-profiles — note enterprise asks for per-route quotas (public ingest vs internal analytics) vs global tenant quota. Which should win? Also need UX for quota unit (tokens, requests, embeddings units).

cory: Product take: support both. Default to tenant-level quota with optional per-route overrides. Add named quota profiles (e.g., "gold", "standard") to make it easier to reuse. For routing: let customers set a priority list of model variants and a fallback policy (auto-quantized / lower-cost). That lets us surface cost tradeoffs in the UI.

kevin: quick example policy snippet for the backend (proto):
```
policy: \n  role: "Viewer"\n  scope: ["/api/ingest/*"]\n  quotas: { unit: "tokens", limit: 10000, type: "daily", mode: "hard" }\n  routing: { priority: ["redwood-xl", "redwood-xl-quant"], fallback: "lower-cost" }\n```
This maps cleanly to our routing engine if we keep scope patterns small.

deploy-bot: :rocket: rollout started for feature/permissions-scope-wizard -> staging (job 4529)

julia: One UX open question: when someone edits a profile that is in-use across tenants, we should warn and offer canary rollout (apply to 5% of requests first). Add toggle in the edit modal.

maria: Agreed. Action items: kevin to finalize backend shape (due EOD Wed), julia to iterate mocks with preview + canary toggle (EOD Thu), anas to draft audit/approval requirements. I'll capture in the RFC and ping infra for any telemetry needs (cost/latency per policy). Thanks all :raised_hands:
